city.name: Jaipur
city.tagline: Pink sandstone, mirrored palaces and bazaars that trade until late.

passes.label: Composite Monument Ticket
passes.detail: One ticket for Amber, Hawa Mahal, Jantar Mantar, Albert Hall, Nahargarh and Isarlat, valid two days (Indian-national rate).

hotels.name: Zostel Jaipur
hotels.summary: Social hostel in a converted haveli with a rooftop café; dorm beds and a few private rooms.

hotels.name: Hotel Pearl Palace
hotels.summary: Family-run guesthouse known for hand-painted rooms and its carved-peacock rooftop restaurant.

hotels.name: Hotel Arya Niwas
hotels.summary: Quiet garden-courtyard hotel a ten-minute walk from Sindhi Camp bus stand and the railway station.

hotels.name: Umaid Bhawan Heritage House
hotels.summary: Rajput-style heritage house with mirrored suites and a rooftop pool, close to the station.

hotels.name: Alsisar Haveli
hotels.summary: A 19th-century haveli of courtyards, frescoes and a pool, minutes from the old-city walls.

hotels.name: Shahpura House
hotels.summary: Painted ceilings, a rooftop restaurant with Nahargarh views and a calm Bani Park setting.

hotels.name: Samode Haveli
hotels.summary: A 250-year-old haveli with a fabled painted dining hall, on the walled city's northern edge.

attractions.name: Amber Fort
attractions.summary: Hilltop palace of mirrored halls and pale sandstone ramparts above Maota Lake.
attractions.tip: Walk up from Suraj Pol rather than queueing for jeeps; the Sheesh Mahal is the payoff.

attractions.name: Hawa Mahal
attractions.summary: Honeycomb façade of 953 latticed windows, built so royal women could watch street life unseen.
attractions.tip: The best photograph is from the first-floor cafés across the road, not from inside.

attractions.name: City Palace
attractions.summary: Working royal residence: Mubarak Mahal textiles, the Peacock Gate and Diwan-i-Khas's silver urns.
attractions.tip: Look up in Pritam Niwas Chowk — each of the four gates is a season.

attractions.name: Jantar Mantar
attractions.summary: UNESCO-listed field of masonry astronomical instruments, including the world's largest stone sundial.
attractions.tip: Hire the audio guide — without it the instruments are beautiful but baffling.

attractions.name: Albert Hall Museum
attractions.summary: Indo-Saracenic museum of Rajasthani miniatures, armour and an Egyptian mummy.
attractions.tip: Come back after dark: the façade is floodlit and Masala Chowk is next door.

attractions.name: Nahargarh Fort
attractions.summary: Ridge-top fort with the finest sunset over the Pink City's grid of rooftops.
attractions.tip: Stake out the Padao terrace 45 minutes before sunset.

attractions.name: Jaigarh Fort
attractions.summary: Military fort guarding Amber, home to Jaivana — once the world's largest cannon on wheels.
attractions.tip: The ramparts give the best top-down view of Amber Fort.

attractions.name: Jal Mahal
attractions.summary: A five-storey palace adrift in Man Sagar Lake, seen from the promenade.
attractions.tip: Golden hour turns the lake to copper; skip the boat touts.

attractions.name: Panna Meena ka Kund
attractions.summary: A geometric stepwell of criss-crossing staircases below Amber.
attractions.tip: Stairs are roped off; photograph from the rim.

attractions.name: Birla Mandir
attractions.summary: White-marble Lakshmi Narayan temple that glows under floodlights at dusk.
attractions.tip: Shoes off at the gate; photography inside is not allowed.

attractions.name: Patrika Gate
attractions.summary: A riot of hand-painted Rajasthani murals — the most photographed gateway in the city.

attractions.name: Isarlat (Swargasuli)
attractions.summary: Seven-tiered minaret with a corkscrew ramp and a 360° view over the bazaars.
attractions.tip: The entrance is down a lane behind the Tripolia shops — ask for Swargasuli.

attractions.name: Galta Ji (Monkey Temple)
attractions.summary: Pink-sandstone temples in a rocky gorge with spring-fed kunds — and resident macaques.
attractions.tip: Keep food out of sight; the monkeys are bold.

attractions.name: Anokhi Museum of Hand Printing
attractions.summary: A restored haveli devoted to block printing, with live carving and printing demonstrations.

eateries.name: Rawat Mishtan Bhandar
eateries.summary: The city's benchmark pyaaz kachori, fried in batches from dawn.

eateries.name: Lassiwala
eateries.summary: Thick lassi in clay cups; the original stall sells out by mid-afternoon.

eateries.name: Peacock Rooftop Restaurant
eateries.summary: Whimsical carved-peacock rooftop above Hotel Pearl Palace.

eateries.name: Tapri Central
eateries.summary: Rooftop chai house over Central Park with an all-day vegetarian menu.

eateries.name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
eateries.summary: Since 1954: silver-plated thalis and ghewar in the heart of Johari Bazaar.

eateries.name: Natraj Restaurant
eateries.summary: Old-school MI Road dining room serving unlimited thalis.

eateries.name: Masala Chowk
eateries.summary: Open-air food court gathering the old city's legendary street-food stalls.

eateries.name: Handi Restaurant
eateries.summary: Courtyard grill house famous for fiery laal maas.

eateries.name: Anokhi Café
eateries.summary: Calm café above the Anokhi flagship — organic salads and the best bread basket in town.

eateries.name: Amer Town Dhabas
eateries.summary: Simple family kitchens in Amer town below the fort's Suraj Pol.

eateries.name: 1135 AD
eateries.summary: Dining inside Amber Fort's Jaleb Chowk, under chandeliers and mirrored arches.

eateries.name: Suvarna Mahal
eateries.summary: The gilded former ballroom of Rambagh Palace — Jaipur's grandest dinner.

markets.name: Johari Bazaar
markets.crafts: Gemstones, kundan jewellery, bandhani & leheriya textiles
markets.summary: The jewellers' bazaar: gem cutters upstairs, sari shops and sweet-sellers below.

markets.name: Bapu Bazaar
markets.crafts: Mojari slippers, block-printed cotton, camel-leather bags
markets.summary: Pink-arcaded lane of juttis, quilts and printed fabric — bargain hard.

markets.name: Tripolia Bazaar
markets.summary: Manihar lane where lac bangles are heated and pressed while you wait.

markets.name: Nehru Bazaar
markets.summary: Fabric and attar shops stacked along the old city wall.

activities.name: Chokhi Dhani Village Evening
activities.pitch: a Chokhi Dhani village evening with folk dance and a thali dinner
activities.summary: Recreated Rajasthani village: folk dance, puppetry and an unlimited thali dinner.

activities.name: Raj Mandir Cinema
activities.pitch: a Bollywood night at the Raj Mandir
activities.summary: Meringue-pink 1976 movie palace — watch a Bollywood blockbuster with a roaring crowd.

activities.name: Private Old-City Food Walk
activities.pitch: a private guided old-city food walk
activities.summary: Three hours, eleven tastings — kachori, kulfi, dal-bati and the lanes between, with a local food writer.

activities.name: Sanganer Block-Printing Workshop
activities.summary: Carve and print your own cotton scarf with a Sanganeri printing family.

activities.name: Rajasthani Home Cooking Class
activities.summary: Cook dal, gatte ki sabzi and rotis in a family kitchen, then eat what you made.

activities.name: Dawn Heritage Walk
activities.pitch: a dawn heritage walk through the craft lanes
activities.summary: Walk the walled city's craft lanes as the bazaars wake up.

activities.name: Hot-Air Balloon over Amber
activities.pitch: a sunrise hot-air balloon flight over Amber
activities.summary: Sunrise flight over Amber Fort, the Aravallis and village fields; hotel pick-up included.
